must_flow.name: preserved_filename_flows_to_open_path

must_not_flow.name: nearby_unsupported_fieldname_and_data_bytes_do_not_flow

must_kill.name: keep_filename_guard_disabled_kills_flow

notes: must_flow: filename variable drives FormParser(file_name=filename); File.__init__ assigns self._file_base/self._ext, fname is derived, path = os.path.join(file_dir, fname), and open(path, "w+b") is called, matching all CTPC edges.
must_not_flow: the taint is passed via field_name and parser.write(data); CTPC does not capture field_name nor treat data bytes as a source at parser.write, so no propagation to open(path).

must_kill: although file_name is tainted, keep_filename is set to False, so the guarded join path does not use the attacker filename; path is built from a safe default, preventing the risky flow as per the guard semantics in the CTPC.
